items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the Bürgergeld decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 2026-11-19, sent by simple mail. Per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (current wording, 4-day rule) it is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after dispatch: 2026-11-19 + 4 days = 2026-11-23 (Monday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or Brandenburg public holiday, so no shift applies. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from this Bekanntgabe day. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (2026-11-23) is excluded, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a month-long period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the event, i.e. 2026-12-23 (Wednesday). This day is not a weekend day or holiday in Brandenburg, so it stands as the final day.

items.title: Submit landlord's 2025 utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die Nebenkostenabrechnung Ihres Vermieters für 2025 bis 08.01.2027 ein.
items.computation: The Jobcenter states an explicit calendar deadline of 08.01.2027 for submitting the 2025 Nebenkostenabrechnung. 2027-01-08 falls on a Friday, which is not a weekend day, and is not a public holiday in Brandenburg (Epiphany, 06.01, is not a Brandenburg holiday), so the stated date applies unchanged.

warnings: The letterhead prints the Jobcenter's own IBAN on every page; German authorities do not normally require you to pay anything to them in a benefit-approval letter, so if any part of this correspondence later asks you to send money to that account, verify it independently with the Jobcenter before paying.
